ground_truth.what_company_does: Provides a non-invasive oral fluid test to detect lead exposure, replacing traditional blood-based testing methods.
ground_truth.business_model: Medical device / diagnostic testing (B2B healthcare / public sector)
ground_truth.revenue_model: Likely revenue from sale of test kits and/or lab processing services (not explicitly stated in deck)
ground_truth.go_to_market: Institutional distribution through schools, public health programs, Medicaid programs, and healthcare providers
ground_truth.target_customer: Children requiring lead testing, with buyers including public health agencies, schools, and healthcare providers
ground_truth.traction_summary: No explicit traction metrics provided; deck focuses on problem scale and solution benefits
ground_truth.market_positioning: Positions itself as a solution to low compliance in mandated lead testing due to barriers in traditional blood testing
ground_truth.competitive_differentiation: Non-invasive testing, easier collection, reduced cost, no medical waste, and higher claimed accuracy versus blood testing
key_strengths: Clear and urgent public health problem
Non-invasive solution reduces friction and increases compliance
Strong usability advantages (no needles, no trained staff required)
Can be deployed in decentralized environments (schools, community sites)
key_risks: Requires regulatory approval and clinical validation
Accuracy claims may require strong evidence to be trusted
Go-to-market execution dependent on government and institutional adoption
investor_relevance_notes: This is a regulated medical/diagnostic product, not a typical SaaS business
Primary risk is validation and adoption, not technology alone
Distribution likely requires partnerships with healthcare systems or public agencies
Market is large but access is policy-driven
